![AI + Automation: Why AI is the Next Step for Automation](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/08171540-1833-0139-0000-f5aaef224cdb:6)
AI automation is `the use of artificial intelligence models combined with software workflows to perform complex, multi-step tasks that once required human judgment` . Unlike rigid, rule-based automation, it interprets messy real-world data, makes decisions, and adapts when conditions change.[](https://www.make.com/en/blog/what-is-ai-automation) [[1]](https://www.make.com/en/blog/what-is-ai-automation)

How AI Automation Works

- **Trigger:** An event starts the process, like a new email, form submission, or payment.
- **Reasoning:** An AI model (like an LLM) reads and understands the context of the input data.
- **Action:** The system executes the task, such as writing a reply draft, updating a database , or sending a message.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gFSkmD8vbfg&t=223) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gFSkmD8vbfg&t=223)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5TxSqvPbnWw&t=936)[[3]](https://www.oracle.com/artificial-intelligence/ai-automation/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/LHHpZasH7YA)

Popular Tools to Build Workflows

- **Workflow Builders:** Platforms like Make or Zapier connect different apps together visually.
- **AI Models:** Engines like OpenAI's ChatGPT or Anthropic Claude provide the "thinking" layer.
- **Data Storage:** Spreadsheets and databases like Google Sheets or Airtable hold your information.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5TxSqvPbnWw&t=936)
